drills.title: Ball mastery routine
drills.summary: Short sets of toe taps, sole rolls and inside-outside touches to build close control on both feet.
drills.setup: A ball and a 2 by 2 m space.
instructions: Toe taps: tap the top of the ball with the sole of each foot in turn.
Sole rolls: roll the ball side to side under the sole, then switch feet.
Inside-inside: knock the ball between the insides of your feet, staying on your toes.
Do 30 seconds of each with a short rest between; three rounds.
coaching_points: Light, quick touches on the balls of your feet.
Use both feet equally.
Keep the ball close: it should never leave your 2 by 2 m space.
drills.indoors: Works as written on a rug or hard floor with a soft or futsal ball. Socks off or trainers on, not socks alone, so the player doesn't slip.

variations.title: Slow touches
variations.change: Twenty slow touches of each, counting out loud; stop and reset whenever the ball runs away.
instructions: Toe taps: twenty slow taps, alternating feet.
Sole rolls: ten each way with each foot.
Inside-inside: twenty touches, slowly.
Count out loud; reset the ball whenever it gets away.

variations.title: Timed sets
variations.change: Thirty seconds of each touch; count your touches and try to beat it next time.

variations.title: Weaker foot only
variations.change: Sole rolls, pull-backs and inside-outside touches with the weaker foot only.
instructions: Sole rolls with the weaker foot: 30 seconds.
Pull back with the sole and push forward with the laces, weaker foot only: 30 seconds.
Inside then outside of the weaker foot, moving side to side: 30 seconds.
Three rounds; count your touches.

variations.title: Combinations at speed
variations.change: Link touches into combinations (pull back and turn, roll and cut, inside-outside and go) as fast as control allows.
instructions: Pull back with the sole and turn away with the inside of the same foot.
Sole roll across the body, then cut back with the inside of the other foot.
Inside-outside, then push out two steps and stop the ball dead.
Thirty seconds per combination, both feet; three rounds.
coaching_points: Speed comes after control: slow down if the ball leaves your space.
Look up between combinations.
Finish each one balanced, ready for the next touch.

drills.title: Wall passes and first touch
drills.summary: Pass against a wall and control the rebound: two touches, then one, then receiving across the body.
drills.setup: A flat wall with no windows and a ball. The player stands 3 m from the wall.
instructions: Pass against the wall with the inside of the foot.
Control the rebound with the first touch out of your feet, to one side.
Pass again with the second touch; alternate feet.
Thirty passes, or as many as you can in two minutes.
coaching_points: Standing foot beside the ball, pointing at the wall.
Cushion the rebound: a soft, relaxed foot.
Take the first touch out of your feet, so the second touch is a pass, not another control.
drills.indoors: A soft or futsal ball against a solid wall or the bottom of a sofa, from 2 m, with gentle passes. Or a parent kneels 2 m away and rolls it back instead of a wall.

variations.title: Parent rolls, you stop it
variations.change: A parent rolls the ball from 4 m; stop it with the sole or inside of the foot, then pass it back.
variations.setup: A parent kneels or stands 4 m from the player with a ball.
instructions: The parent rolls the ball along the ground to the player.
Stop it dead with the sole, or with the inside of the foot.
Pass it back with the inside of the foot; swap feet each time.
Twenty rolls.

variations.title: Two-touch wall passes
variations.change: Pass, control out of your feet, pass again, from 3 m.

variations.title: One touch, alternating feet
variations.change: Pass the rebound straight back first time, alternating feet.
instructions: Pass against the wall and play the rebound straight back first time.
Alternate feet every pass.
Count your longest run without a miss; start again after a miss.

variations.title: Touch across the body
variations.change: Receive with the back foot and take the first touch across your body through a cone gate to the side, then pass.
variations.setup: A flat wall with no windows and a ball. The player stands 3 m from the wall, with a cone 2 m out to each side.
instructions: Pass against the wall.
Open your body and take the rebound across you with the back foot, past one cone.
Pass from there, then go to the other side next time.
Twenty passes, alternating sides.
coaching_points: Open your hips to where you want the ball to go before it arrives.
Receive with the foot furthest from the wall.
Touch it far enough to pass with the next touch.

media.caption: Pass against the wall, touch out of your feet, pass again

steps.label: Pass against the wall with the inside of the foot
First touch out of your feet, to the side
Pass again with the other foot
Touch the other way, and keep going

media.caption: Easier: a parent rolls, you stop it and pass it back

steps.label: The parent rolls the ball along the ground
Stop it dead with the sole
Pass it back with the inside of the foot

media.caption: Hardest: receive across the body past a cone, then pass

steps.label: Pass against the wall; open your body to the right
First touch across your body, past the right-hand cone
Pass from there
Touch across the other way, past the left-hand cone

drills.title: Keep-ups
drills.summary: Keep the ball off the ground with the feet and thighs, building from one bounce per touch to sequences.
drills.setup: A ball and a 3 by 3 m space with nothing breakable nearby.
instructions: Drop the ball onto your foot and kick it gently up to waist height.
Keep it up with your feet only, as many touches as you can.
Count your best and try to beat it each session.
coaching_points: Lock the ankle with the toes slightly up, so the ball comes straight up.
Small touches to waist height, not big kicks.
Stay on your toes and move your feet under the ball.
drills.indoors: Use a balloon or a very soft ball; balloon keep-ups are ideal for the youngest players. No heading indoors.

variations.title: One bounce between touches
variations.change: Let the ball bounce once between touches.
instructions: Drop the ball, let it bounce, then kick it gently up.
Let it bounce once after every touch.
Count your best run.

variations.title: Feet only
variations.change: No bounces: keep it up with the feet only.

variations.title: Alternate feet
variations.change: Left, right, left: every touch with the other foot.
instructions: Keep it up, alternating feet every touch.
If it goes wrong, one extra touch to recover is allowed, then back to alternating.
Count your best run.

variations.title: Foot and thigh sequences
variations.change: Set sequences: foot, thigh, foot, other foot, other thigh.
instructions: Foot, thigh, foot on one side, then the same on the other.
Then make up your own sequence of five and repeat it.
Count complete sequences.
coaching_points: Thigh level with the hip and flat, so the ball pops straight up.
Keep each touch the same height.
No heading at this age in training; keep it to feet and thighs.

drills.title: Head-up dribbling with calls
drills.summary: Dribble around household items while a parent holds up fingers to call out: control with the head up.
drills.setup: Four cones or household items spread around an 8 by 8 m space. A parent stands at the edge.
instructions: Dribble in and around the items with small touches.
Every few seconds the parent holds up some fingers: call out the number.
Keep dribbling the whole time; two minutes, then rest.
coaching_points: Look up between touches, not only when you hear something.
Use small touches so the ball is still there when you look down.
Feel the ball with your feet: glance at it, don't stare.
drills.indoors: A hallway or cleared room with socks or plastic bottles as the items, a soft ball and walking pace.

variations.title: Look up at each item
variations.change: On your own: every time you pass an item, look up and name something you can see across the room or garden.
variations.setup: Four cones or household items spread around an 8 by 8 m space.
instructions: Dribble around the items.
As you pass each one, look up and name something you can see.
Two minutes, then rest.

variations.title: Call the number
variations.change: The parent holds up fingers; call the number while dribbling.

variations.title: Call and change direction
variations.change: Call the number, then odd means turn left and even means turn right.
instructions: Dribble around the items.
When the parent holds up fingers, call the number.
Odd: turn left. Even: turn right. Then carry on.

variations.title: Call and pass
variations.change: The parent holds up a hand on one side: pass the ball through the gate on that side.
variations.setup: Four items spread around an 8 by 8 m space and two 1 m gates of cones at one end. A parent stands between the gates.
instructions: Dribble around the items.
The parent raises a hand on one side: pass through the gate on that side.
The parent passes the ball back; keep going.
coaching_points: Look up early so you have time to set up the pass.
Decide before you arrive, not after you stop.
Pass with the inside of the foot, weighted to arrive at the gate.

media.caption: Dribble with your head up; call the parent's fingers

steps.label: Dribble between the items with small touches
The parent holds up three fingers: 'Three!'
Keep dribbling; look up again between touches
Two fingers: 'Two!'

media.caption: Easier: look up and name something at each item

steps.label: Dribble to the first item
Passing it: look up and name something you can see
On to the next item, and look up again

media.caption: Hardest: the parent's raised hand says which gate to pass through

steps.label: Dribble between the items with your head up
The parent raises the right hand
Pass through the right-hand gate
The parent passes it back; carry on

drills.title: Moves to beat a defender
drills.summary: Practise a move to beat a defender against a cone, then against a parent who stands in, then one who leans.
drills.setup: A cone as the defender in the middle of a 4 by 10 m strip, with a 2 m gate of two cones at the far end.
instructions: Dribble at the cone at a jog.
About a metre away, do the move: a step-over, a drag-back turn or a scissors.
Accelerate away past the cone and through the gate.
Ten goes with each move; use both feet.
coaching_points: Do the move a metre before the cone, not on top of it.
Sell it: drop the shoulder the way you are pretending to go.
The burst after the move matters as much as the move.
drills.indoors: A hallway with a soft ball and a cushion as the defender. Walk the moves slowly; save the burst for outdoors.

variations.title: One move, walking
variations.change: One move only, at walking pace, then a short push past the cone.
instructions: Walk the ball up to the cone.
Do one move (a step-over or a drag-back) slowly and correctly.
Push the ball past the cone and stop it at the gate.
Ten goes on each foot.

variations.title: Two moves, either foot
variations.change: Practise two moves at a jog, on both feet, and burst away after each.

variations.title: Against a still parent
variations.change: A parent stands in for the cone, with feet apart, and may shuffle sideways but never tackles.
variations.setup: A parent stands in the middle of a 4 by 10 m strip as the defender, with a 2 m gate at the far end.
instructions: Dribble at the parent at a jog.
Do the move as they shuffle across, then accelerate through the gate.
The parent never tackles; they just shuffle to block the way.
Ten goes.

variations.title: Read the lean
variations.change: The parent leans or steps one way at the last moment; go the other way.
variations.setup: A parent stands in the middle of a 4 by 10 m strip as the defender, with a 2 m gate at the far end.
instructions: Dribble at the parent.
As you arrive they lean or step to one side.
Choose a move that takes you the other way, and accelerate through the gate.
Ten goes.
coaching_points: Watch the parent's hips, not their feet.
Keep the ball on the foot you can move it away with.
Decide late, then go fast.

media.caption: Dribble at the cone, do the move a metre away, burst through the gate

steps.label: Dribble at the cone at a jog
A metre away: a step-over, dropping the left shoulder
Push the ball out to the right, past the cone
Accelerate through the gate

media.caption: Harder: a parent shuffles across instead of the cone

steps.label: Dribble at the parent at a jog
The parent shuffles left; the player drops the shoulder that way
Cut right, past the parent
Accelerate through the gate

media.caption: Hardest: the parent leans late; go the other way

steps.label: Dribble at the parent; watch their hips
At the last moment the parent steps to the right
Go the other way: drag back and cut left
Accelerate through the gate

drills.title: Target passing and shooting
drills.summary: Pass into a laundry basket indoors; outdoors, strike low into marked corners of a goal or wall.
drills.setup: Outdoors: a goal, or a wall with two target squares marked low in the corners with tape or cones. Balls 8 m out.
instructions: Strike low at one corner target, then the other.
Ten strikes, counting how many hit a target.
Collect the balls and go again with the other foot.
coaching_points: Standing foot beside the ball, pointing at the target.
Laces through the middle of the ball, head over it, to keep it low.
Pick the target before you strike, and look at it last.
drills.indoors: Only the basket version indoors: a laundry basket on its side 2 to 3 m away, a soft ball and inside-foot passes. No full-power strikes inside.

variations.title: Pass into a basket
variations.change: Pass with the inside of the foot into a laundry basket on its side, 3 m away.
variations.setup: A laundry basket on its side, or a box, 3 m from a row of balls.
instructions: Pass each ball into the basket with the inside of the foot.
Ten passes with each foot; count how many go in.
Move back a step when you get seven out of ten.
coaching_points: Standing foot beside the ball, pointing at the basket.
Lock the ankle and push through the middle of the ball.
Follow through towards the basket.

variations.title: Strike at corner targets
variations.change: Outdoors: strike low with the laces at two corner targets from 8 m.

variations.title: Weaker foot, further out
variations.change: From 12 m, alternating feet; a hit with the weaker foot counts double.
instructions: Strike from 12 m, alternating feet.
Aim for the corner targets; weaker-foot hits count double.
Ten strikes per round; beat your score.

variations.title: Touch and strike off a rebound
variations.change: Pass against a side wall (or a parent rolls the ball in), take one touch to set, then strike at a target.
variations.setup: Outdoors: a goal or target wall, with a side wall or a parent 6 m to one side. Balls 10 m out.
instructions: Pass against the side wall, or ask a parent to roll the ball in.
Take one touch to set the ball towards goal.
Strike low at a corner target.
Ten goes, then switch sides.
coaching_points: Set the ball out of your feet and slightly to the side of your shooting foot.
Look at the target before the ball arrives.
Strike on the second touch, without stopping the ball.

steps.label: Strike low into the left-hand target

media.caption: Easier: pass into a laundry basket

steps.label: Inside of the foot, into the basket

media.caption: Hardest: rebound off a side wall, one touch to set, then strike

steps.label: Pass against the side wall and move to meet the rebound
One touch to set the ball towards goal
Strike low into the far target

drills.title: Goalkeeper catches at home
drills.summary: Catching practice with a parent throwing or a wall rebounding, from kneeling catches to collapse dives on grass.
drills.setup: A parent with a ball, 4 m from the goalkeeper.
instructions: The parent throws underarm at chest height, then low, then above the head.
The goalkeeper catches and holds, then throws it back.
Twenty throws, mixing the heights.
coaching_points: Get set before each throw: feet shoulder-width, knees bent, hands ready.
W-shaped hands for chest and high balls; scoop low ones up into the chest.
Bring every catch into the chest and hold it.
drills.indoors: A soft ball; kneeling catches and gentle wall catches only. No diving indoors.

variations.title: Kneeling catches
variations.change: The goalkeeper kneels; the parent throws gently at the chest and stomach from 3 m.
variations.setup: The goalkeeper kneels upright; a parent with a ball kneels or sits 3 m away.
instructions: The parent throws gently at the goalkeeper's chest.
Catch with W-shaped hands and bring the ball into the chest.
Then throws at the stomach: scoop it up into the chest.
Twenty throws.

variations.title: Throws at three heights
variations.change: Standing, set position; the parent throws at chest, low and high.

variations.title: Wall rebounds
variations.change: On your own: throw the ball against a wall and catch the rebound, moving your feet to get behind it.
variations.setup: A flat wall with no windows. The goalkeeper stands 3 m from it with a ball.
instructions: Throw the ball against the wall at different heights and angles.
Move your feet to get your body behind the rebound, then catch and hold.
Twenty catches; throw harder or stand closer as it gets easy.
coaching_points: Move your feet first, then your hands.
Get your body behind the ball, so a fumble still stays in front of you.
Hold every catch for a second before the next throw.

variations.title: Volleys and collapse dives, outdoors
variations.change: Outdoors on grass only: the parent volleys or throws just out of reach to the side, and the goalkeeper collapse-dives to catch.
variations.setup: Outdoors on soft grass. A parent with balls 5 m from the goalkeeper.
instructions: The parent throws or volleys low, just out of reach to one side.
Step towards the ball and collapse onto your side to catch it.
Get up, set, and go again to the other side.
Ten each side.
coaching_points: Step with the near foot, then go down on your side, not your front.
Hands lead: bottom hand behind the ball, top hand on top.
Get up quickly and set again before the next one.

media.caption: Throws at chest, low and high; catch and hold

steps.label: Chest height: W-shaped hands
Throw it back
Low: scoop it up into the chest
Throw it back; next one is high

media.caption: Easier: kneeling catches

steps.label: A gentle throw at the chest
Catch it into the chest, then throw it back
At the stomach: scoop it up

media.caption: Harder: on your own, off a wall

steps.label: Throw against the wall, off to the right
Feet first: get behind the rebound and catch it
Now off to the left

media.caption: Hardest, outdoors only: collapse dive to catch

steps.label: Low, just out of reach to the right: step and collapse onto your side
Get up, set, and throw it back
Now to the left
